description: Find drum schools, drum and percussion teachers, cajon classes, drum studios, drum circles and drum shops on «Ударная карта» (the Drum Map of cajon.pro): a free, curated map of places in Russia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Belarus and other countries. Search by city, by coordinates with a radius, or by part of the name or address; filter by instrument and kind of place. Returns name, address, phone, website and a link to the place page — give the user that link.

city.description: City, preferably as written locally: «Москва», «Санкт-Петербург», «Алматы», «Ереван», «Минск». English names like Moscow also work.

instrument.description: Only places that teach or play this: cajon, kit (drum kit), djembe, congas (congas and bongos), darbuka, percussion (other percussion).

lat.description: Latitude of the point to search around (use with lon).

lon.description: Longitude of the point to search around (use with lat).

query.description: Words from the name, address or description, e.g. «джембе» or a street name.

name: find_drum_schools
title: Find drum schools and teachers
